blocks.title: The Problem
blocks.content: Finding a specific answer inside a long report or manual means manually scanning through it, and details get missed along the way.

blocks.title: The Solution
blocks.content: NLP combined with OCR reads the uploaded PDF, and text summarization surfaces the relevant answer directly from the document's content.

blocks.title: Outcome
blocks.content: Answers in seconds instead of a manual search through the full document.
